testcase.name: Scenario: Press Escape while the command category list is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:805:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Press Escape while the command category list is open ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ And there are no pending customization changes ✔ When the user opens the command category list ✔ Then All Commands and other categories are visible in the list ✔ When the user presses Down ✔ Then Macros has the keyboard focus in the open list ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the customization dialog and category list close ✔ And the Tools ribbon and part remain visible ✔ When the user reopens customization from the Tools ribbon ✔ Then the category shows All Commands ✔ And the Part Tools target list is empty ✔ When the user clicks Close ✔ Then the dialog closes
